-- Speed Hub X menu replica. All feature callbacks intentionally do nothing.
-- The component tables below are local modules bundled into one executor script.

local playersService = game:GetService("Players")
local userInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local localPlayer = playersService.LocalPlayer

local environment = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or shared or _G
local previousMenu = environment.SpeedHubXMenuReplica
if previousMenu and type(previousMenu.destroy) == "function" then
	pcall(previousMenu.destroy)
end

local Style = {
	window = Color3.fromRGB(8, 8, 8),
	control = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 28),
	controlHover = Color3.fromRGB(34, 34, 34),
	selected = Color3.fromRGB(191, 0, 4),
	selectedIcon = Color3.fromRGB(225, 63, 63),
	text = Color3.fromRGB(239, 239, 239),
	muted = Color3.fromRGB(138, 138, 138),
	icon = Color3.fromRGB(195, 195, 195),
	description = Color3.fromRGB(105, 105, 105),
	toggle = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35),
	red = Color3.fromRGB(221, 0, 6),
	font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
	bold = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
}

local function create(className, properties, parent)
	local object = Instance.new(className)
	for property, value in pairs(properties or {}) do
		object[property] = value
	end
	object.Parent = parent
	return object
end

local function round(parent, radius)
	return create("UICorner", { CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, radius) }, parent)
end

local function label(parent, text, size, color, font)
	return create("TextLabel", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Text = text,
		TextColor3 = color or Style.text,
		Font = font or Style.font,
		TextSize = size,
		TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
		TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
	}, parent)
end

local function line(parent, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, thickness)
	local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
	local segment = create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy), thickness or 2),
		Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx)),
		BackgroundColor3 = color,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, parent)
	round(segment, 2)
	return segment
end

-- Crops from the supplied reference, stored as white alpha masks so they can
-- be tinted for selected and unselected tabs. No network assets are needed.
local IconData = {
	Home = [=[]=],
	Main = [=[]=],
	Farming = [=[]=],
	Killer = [=[]=],
	Misc = [=[]=],
	Arrow = [=[]=],
}

local function decodeBase64(encoded)
	local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
	local lookup, output = {}, {}
	for index = 1, #alphabet do lookup[alphabet:sub(index, index)] = index - 1 end
	local accumulator, bits = 0, 0
	for index = 1, #encoded do
		local value = lookup[encoded:sub(index, index)]
		if value then
			accumulator = accumulator * 64 + value
			bits = bits + 6
			if bits >= 8 then
				bits = bits - 8
				local byte = math.floor(accumulator / 2 ^ bits)
				table.insert(output, string.char(byte % 256))
				accumulator = accumulator % 2 ^ bits
			end
		end
	end
	return table.concat(output)
end


local iconAssets = {}
local function getIconAsset(name)
	if iconAssets[name] then return iconAssets[name] end
	if not IconData[name] or type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return nil end
	local ok, asset = pcall(function()
		local path = "speed_hub_x_replica_icon_v1_" .. name .. ".png"
		writefile(path, decodeBase64(IconData[name]))
		return getcustomasset(path)
	end)
	if ok and type(asset) == "string" and asset ~= "" then
		iconAssets[name] = asset
		return asset
	end
	return nil
end

-- Use cropped icons when custom assets are supported; otherwise draw a fallback.
local Icons = {}
function Icons.draw(parent, kind, color)
	local asset = getIconAsset(kind)
	if asset then
		return create("ImageLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 28),
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0.5, -14),
			Image = asset,
			ImageColor3 = color,
		}, parent)
	end
	local holder = create("Frame", {
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
		Position = UDim2.new(0, 14, 0.5, -12),
	}, parent)
	local function stroke(x1, y1, x2, y2, width)
		line(holder, x1, y1, x2, y2, color, width or 2)
	end
	if kind == "Home" then
		stroke(2, 8, 2, 4) stroke(2, 4, 6, 4)
		stroke(18, 4, 22, 4) stroke(22, 4, 22, 8)
		stroke(2, 16, 2, 20) stroke(2, 20, 6, 20)
		stroke(18, 20, 22, 20) stroke(22, 20, 22, 16)
		stroke(7, 8, 9, 8) stroke(15, 8, 17, 8)
		stroke(7, 14, 10, 17) stroke(10, 17, 14, 17) stroke(14, 17, 17, 14)
	elseif kind == "Main" then
		stroke(2, 11, 12, 3) stroke(12, 3, 22, 11)
		stroke(5, 10, 5, 21) stroke(5, 21, 19, 21) stroke(19, 21, 19, 10)
		stroke(10, 21, 10, 14) stroke(10, 14, 14, 14) stroke(14, 14, 14, 21)
	elseif kind == "Farming" then
		stroke(5, 4, 21, 21, 3) stroke(4, 6, 9, 3, 3)
		stroke(9, 3, 16, 4, 3) stroke(4, 6, 2, 11, 3)
	elseif kind == "Killer" then
		stroke(3, 8, 3, 17) stroke(3, 8, 6, 6) stroke(6, 6, 8, 7)
		stroke(8, 7, 10, 5) stroke(10, 5, 13, 6) stroke(13, 6, 15, 5)
		stroke(15, 5, 18, 7) stroke(18, 7, 21, 9) stroke(21, 9, 21, 17)
		stroke(3, 17, 6, 20) stroke(6, 20, 18, 20) stroke(18, 20, 21, 17)
		stroke(8, 9, 8, 15) stroke(12, 8, 12, 15) stroke(16, 8, 16, 15)
	else
		stroke(2, 20, 7, 4) stroke(7, 4, 12, 12) stroke(12, 12, 15, 7)
		stroke(15, 7, 22, 20) stroke(22, 20, 2, 20) stroke(6, 16, 18, 16)
	end
	return holder
end

-- Only UI state changes; no game feature is implemented.
local Features = {}
function Features.autoUltimate(enabled) end
function Features.autoDash(enabled) end
function Features.aimPartChanged(value) end
function Features.aimlock(enabled) end
function Features.antiKnockback(enabled) end
function Features.antiStun(enabled) end
function Features.antiBusy(enabled) end

local screen = create("ScreenGui", {
	Name = "SpeedHubXMenuReplica",
	ResetOnSpawn = false,
	IgnoreGuiInset = true,
	DisplayOrder = 100,
	ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling,
})

-- Try executor UI protection, then fall back through common GUI containers.
if type(syn) == "table" and type(syn.protect_gui) == "function" then
	pcall(syn.protect_gui, screen)
elseif type(protectgui) == "function" then
	pcall(protectgui, screen)
end
local parented = false
if type(gethui) == "function" then
	local ok, container = pcall(gethui)
	if ok and container then
		parented = pcall(function() screen.Parent = container end)
	end
end
if not parented then
	parented = pcall(function() screen.Parent = game:GetService("CoreGui") end)
end
if not parented then
	local playerGui = localPlayer and localPlayer:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	if not playerGui and localPlayer then
		playerGui = localPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui", 10)
	end
	if playerGui then
		parented = pcall(function() screen.Parent = playerGui end)
	end
end
if not parented then
	screen:Destroy()
	warn("Speed Hub X: no accessible GUI container was found.")
	return
end

local connections = {}
local function connect(signal, callback)
	local connection = signal:Connect(callback)
	table.insert(connections, connection)
	return connection
end

local Window = {}
function Window.new()
	local window = create("Frame", {
		Name = "Window",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.58, 0.495),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(1016, 646),
		BackgroundColor3 = Style.window,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		ClipsDescendants = true,
	}, screen)
	round(window, 12)
	local scale = create("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, window)

	local titleBar = create("Frame", {
		Name = "TitleBar",
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 58),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Active = true,
	}, window)
	local title = label(titleBar, "Speed Hub X | Version: 3.7.0", 19)
	title.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 0)
	title.Size = UDim2.new(1, -90, 1, 0)

	local close = create("TextButton", {
		Name = "Close",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -50, 0, 4),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(43, 43),
		Text = "×",
		TextColor3 = Style.text,
		TextSize = 31,
		Font = Enum.Font.Gotham,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, titleBar)
	close.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() window.Visible = false end)

	local dragging, dragStart, startPosition, dragInput
	titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		dragging, dragStart, startPosition = true, input.Position, window.Position
		connect(input.Changed, function()
			if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then dragging = false end
		end)
	end)
	titleBar.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	connect(userInputService.InputChanged, function(input)
		if dragging and input == dragInput then
			local delta = input.Position - dragStart
			window.Position = UDim2.new(startPosition.X.Scale, startPosition.X.Offset + delta.X, startPosition.Y.Scale, startPosition.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
		end
	end)
	return window, scale
end

-- Captured from the supplied reference; fall back to a text mark if an executor
-- does not expose a writable filesystem and custom assets.
local logoBase64 = [=[]=]

local function getLogoAsset()
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(getcustomasset) ~= "function" then return nil end
	local ok, asset = pcall(function()
		local path = "speed_hub_x_menu_replica_logo.png"
		writefile(path, decodeBase64(logoBase64))
		return getcustomasset(path)
	end)
	if ok then return asset end
	return nil
end

local window, windowScale = Window.new()
local launcher = create("ImageButton", {
	Name = "OpenMenu",
	Size = UDim2.fromOffset(65, 66),
	BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(3, 3, 3),
	BorderSizePixel = 0,
	Image = getLogoAsset() or "",
	AutoButtonColor = false,
}, screen)
round(launcher, 8)
local launcherScale = create("UIScale", { Scale = 1 }, launcher)
if launcher.Image == "" then
	local fallback = label(launcher, "S", 38, Style.red, Style.bold)
	fallback.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	fallback.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
end
launcher.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() window.Visible = not window.Visible end)

local function updateScale()
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	local viewport = camera and camera.ViewportSize or Vector2.new(1568, 831)
	if viewport.X < 100 or viewport.Y < 100 then return end
	local scale = math.min(1, (viewport.X - 24) / 1016, (viewport.Y - 24) / 646)
	windowScale.Scale = scale
	launcherScale.Scale = scale
	-- Align with the reference while keeping both pieces onscreen on small displays.
	local centerX = math.clamp(viewport.X * 0.58, 508 * scale + 12, viewport.X - 508 * scale - 12)
	window.Position = UDim2.new(0, centerX, 0.495, 0)
	launcher.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(8, centerX - 676 * scale), math.max(8, viewport.Y * 0.495 - 247 * scale))
end
local cameraConnection
local function observeCamera()
	if cameraConnection then cameraConnection:Disconnect() end
	local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if camera then cameraConnection = connect(camera:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"), updateScale) end
	updateScale()
end
connect(workspace:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CurrentCamera"), observeCamera)
observeCamera()

local Navigation = {}
function Navigation.new(parent)
	local sidebar = create("Frame", {
		Name = "Navigation",
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(19, 71),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 260),
	}, parent)
	create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 9), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, sidebar)
	local navigation = { buttons = {}, pages = {} }
	function navigation:add(name, order, page)
		local button = create("TextButton", {
			Name = name,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(260, 44),
			BackgroundColor3 = Style.control,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = "",
			AutoButtonColor = false,
			LayoutOrder = order,
		}, sidebar)
		round(button, 12)
		local icon = Icons.draw(button, name, Style.icon)
		local text = label(button, "| " .. name, 16, Style.muted)
		text.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(45, 0)
		text.Size = UDim2.new(1, -50, 1, 0)
		self.buttons[name] = { button = button, text = text, icon = icon }
		self.pages[name] = page
		button.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() self:select(name) end)
	end
	function navigation:select(name)
		for pageName, page in pairs(self.pages) do page.Visible = pageName == name end
		for tabName, tab in pairs(self.buttons) do
			local selected = tabName == name
			tab.button.BackgroundColor3 = selected and Style.selected or Style.control
			tab.text.TextColor3 = selected and Style.selectedIcon or Style.muted
			local iconColor = selected and Style.selectedIcon or Style.icon
			if tab.icon:IsA("ImageLabel") then
				tab.icon.ImageColor3 = iconColor
			else
				for _, segment in ipairs(tab.icon:GetChildren()) do
					if segment:IsA("Frame") then segment.BackgroundColor3 = iconColor end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return navigation
end

local Controls = {}
function Controls.section(parent, text, order)
	local heading = label(parent, text, 23, Style.text, Style.bold)
	heading.Name = text .. "Section"
	-- The later section headings have a slightly larger gap above them.
	heading.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, text == "Skill" and 31 or 41)
	heading.TextYAlignment = text == "Skill" and Enum.TextYAlignment.Center or Enum.TextYAlignment.Bottom
	heading.LayoutOrder = order
	create("UIPadding", { PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, 8) }, heading)
	return heading
end

function Controls.toggle(parent, title, description, initial, callback, order)
	local row = create("TextButton", {
		Name = title,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 55),
		BackgroundColor3 = Style.control,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		LayoutOrder = order,
	}, parent)
	round(row, 10)
	local name = label(row, title, 16)
	name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 7)
	name.Size = UDim2.new(1, -75, 0, 20)
	local detail = label(row, description, 13, Style.description)
	detail.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 29)
	detail.Size = UDim2.new(1, -75, 0, 17)
	local box = create("Frame", {
		Name = "Toggle",
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(37, 37),
		BackgroundColor3 = Style.toggle,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, row)
	round(box, 9)
	local dot = create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(24, 24),
		BackgroundColor3 = Style.red,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Visible = initial,
	}, box)
	round(dot, 99)
	local enabled = initial
	row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
		enabled = not enabled
		dot.Visible = enabled
		callback(enabled)
	end)
	return row
end

function Controls.dropdown(parent, title, options, initial, callback, order)
	local holder = create("Frame", {
		Name = title,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46),
		ClipsDescendants = true,
		LayoutOrder = order,
	}, parent)
	local row = create("TextButton", {
		Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46),
		BackgroundColor3 = Style.control,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		Text = "",
		AutoButtonColor = false,
	}, holder)
	round(row, 10)
	local name = label(row, title, 16)
	name.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0)
	name.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -30, 1, 0)
	local current = create("Frame", {
		AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),
		Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 0.5, 0),
		Size = UDim2.new(0.41, 0, 0, 34),
		BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(37, 37, 37),
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
	}, row)
	round(current, 6)
	local value = label(current, initial, 23, Style.text, Style.bold)
	value.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	value.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	local arrowAsset = getIconAsset("Arrow")
	local arrow
	if arrowAsset then
		arrow = create("ImageLabel", {
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Image = arrowAsset,
			ImageColor3 = Style.text,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 13),
		}, row)
	else
		arrow = label(row, "⌃", 25, Style.text, Style.bold)
		arrow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(20, 28)
		arrow.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
	end
	arrow.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
	arrow.Position = UDim2.new(0.59, -25, 0.5, 0)
	local expanded = false
	local function setExpanded(state)
		expanded = state
		holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46 + (state and (#options * 37 + 5) or 0))
		arrow.Rotation = state and 180 or 0
	end
	row.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() setExpanded(not expanded) end)
	for index, option in ipairs(options) do
		local optionButton = create("TextButton", {
			Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 46 + (index - 1) * 37 + 5),
			Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 35),
			BackgroundColor3 = Style.controlHover,
			BorderSizePixel = 0,
			Text = option,
			TextSize = 15,
			TextColor3 = Style.text,
			Font = Style.font,
			AutoButtonColor = true,
		}, holder)
		round(optionButton, 7)
		optionButton.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
			value.Text = option
			setExpanded(false)
			callback(option)
		end)
	end
	return holder
end

local function createPage(name)
	local page = create("ScrollingFrame", {
		Name = name .. "Page",
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(315, 66),
		Size = UDim2.new(1, -333, 1, -78),
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		BorderSizePixel = 0,
		CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y,
		ScrollBarThickness = 0,
		ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y,
		Visible = false,
	}, window)
	create("UIListLayout", { Padding = UDim.new(0, 8), SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder }, page)
	return page
end

local navigation = Navigation.new(window)
local names = { "Home", "Main", "Farming", "Killer", "Misc" }
local pages = {}
for index, name in ipairs(names) do
	pages[name] = createPage(name)
	navigation:add(name, index, pages[name])
end

-- The screenshot shows Main only; the other tabs intentionally have no invented content.
local main = pages.Main
Controls.section(main, "Skill", 1)
Controls.toggle(main, "Auto Ultimate", "This is Meaning Auto Use Ultimate", true, Features.autoUltimate, 2)
Controls.toggle(main, "Auto Dash", "This is Meaning Auto Use Dash", true, Features.autoDash, 3)
Controls.section(main, "Aim", 4)
Controls.dropdown(main, "Choose Aim Part", { "Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso" }, "Head", Features.aimPartChanged, 5)
Controls.toggle(main, "Aimlock", "Aimlock = Lock Camera Player", false, Features.aimlock, 6)
Controls.section(main, "Body", 7)
Controls.toggle(main, "Anti-Knockback", "BETA", false, Features.antiKnockback, 8)
Controls.toggle(main, "Anti-Stun", "BETA", false, Features.antiStun, 9)
Controls.toggle(main, "Anti-Busy", "BETA", false, Features.antiBusy, 10)
navigation:select("Main")

environment.SpeedHubXMenuReplica = {
	destroy = function()
		for _, connection in ipairs(connections) do connection:Disconnect() end
		screen:Destroy()
	end,
}
